subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a core session-level process/step event protocol now, and what privacy, replay, and compatibility contract should it expose?
rationale: The request is a new public event protocol and security boundary, not a broken existing behavior with an already-defined fix.

options.title: Design core process events
options.body: Approve an additive process/step event contract covering sequence, stable step IDs, related IDs, retention, replay, authorization, and redaction before implementation.

options.title: Fold into related progress work
options.body: Make the inter-session progress and native-runtime progress issues consume a shared process-event design instead of creating separate event surfaces.

options.title: Defer public contract
options.body: Keep current generic agent streams until a maintainer-sponsored client integration defines the durable protocol requirements.

recommendation.title: Design core process events
recommendation.body: Approve an additive process/step event contract covering sequence, stable step IDs, related IDs, retention, replay, authorization, and redaction before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history signal for coordinating the session/Gateway/UI product contract across the related surfaces.
